description: The manager's own local window. Seven commands and nothing else: pair, install, control, status, revoke, check-mcp (a read-only probe of the MT5 address and token, so the panel can answer before a download). No fs, shell, opener, clipboard, http or event-bus plugin reaches this webview; every schtasks, taskkill, mise and cloudflared call runs in Rust behind the CommandRunner seam (AC-2, D-030's lockdown). Unlike the v0.2 shell this capability is local, not remote: the hub page never loads inside this app, so there is no remote origin to scope.
